messages:
Clara (docs): opened a PR to correct the model-catalog card for fulcrum-lite-quant: deprecation flag, correct sequence/ctx table, replace embed example that used generate. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/611

Omar (ml-infra): I'll re-run perf on our A100s. Old numbers came from quant-legacy; quant-v2 shows better short-context throughput. Will post numbers + bench command later today.

Tess (runtime): FYI runtime detail: fulcrum-lite-quant enables fused-attn and fused-kv only on runtime >=1.17. Add a compatibility sentence: "Runtime >= 1.17 required for fused kernels; older runtimes will fallback to slower paths."

Rohan (sdk): Noticed the generate->embed mixup. Proposed snippets to replace both examples:
Python: `resp = client.embeddings.create(model=\"fulcrum-embed-1\", input=[\"hello\"])`
JS: `const e = await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'fulcrum-embed-1', input: ['hello'] })`
Also recommend a one-line migration: "If you used fulcrum-lite-quant for embeddings via generate, migrate to fulcrum-embed-1 or the embeddings endpoint."

Clara (docs): adding those snippets. Also proposing a short deprecation window so CS can notify Dedicated customers: "Deprecated 2026-05-15; unsupported after 2026-08-15. Contact support for extended access." Tagging Nadia for outreach.

Nadia (cs): Thanks, will prepare an outreach draft once the PR is merged. Please add a note in the card that Dedicated tenants may request extended availability.

Omar (ml-infra): Quick bench (A100, quant-v2): ctx 4096, batch 1 -> 760 tok/s (old card: 690 tok/s). Command: `./bench --model fulcrum-lite-quant --profile quant-v2 --ctx 4096 --batch 1 --device a100`. Logs attached in PR comments.

Tess (runtime): added runtime min version to PR and a short line that fallback increases p99 latency ~2-3x.

Clara (docs): CI linkcheck failed on one internal anchor in the SDK guide. Will wait for Rohan to push a tiny anchor fix.

ci-bot: docs/linkcheck failed (1 broken anchor)

Rohan (sdk): pushed anchor fix to the docs branch, re-run requested.

ci-bot: docs/linkcheck re-run queued by Rohan (sdk)

Clara (docs): great. If CI passes I'll merge and tag CS for the planned outreach. Thanks everyone for quick reviews. :rocket:
